description: We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary of $85,000 - $95,000 and an immediate opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a collaborative and supportive environment for our nursing staff. We are looking for a visionary leader who is passionate about quality outcomes and committed to excellence in a skilled nursing setting. Join a team that values your expertise and dedication.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility.
Proven leadership and management abilities, with a focus on staff development and patient care excellence.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
